item.title: Stephen King's Hit Horror TV Series Officially Returning to HBO Max
item.description: It’s been a pretty great year to be a horror fan. Obsession became one of 2026’s biggest surprise hits, Backrooms turned an internet nightmare into a box-office smash, and even smaller releases like Hokum found an audience. And now, one of the most iconic stories from horror legend Stephen King is getting another chapter. HBO has officially renewed It: Welcome to Derry for a second season, sending Pennywise and the cursed Maine town even further into the past.

item.title: 27 Years Later, the Best Action Adventure Movie of 1999 Is Officially Free on Youtube
item.description: No one really knows why a movie works. After a century of Hollywood, the industry is still trying to understand and adapt to an ever-evolving audience. As we enter an era of peak remake and IP-grab filmmaking, stories from decades ago have become the studios’ easiest bets to make money. It’s not fertile ground for creativity, but we movie fans have to take our wins where we can.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney's New Netflix Sci-Fi Space Epic Gets First Details
item.description: The live-action Gundam film has been in the works in some form or another since 2018. A director and cast have been announced, including high-profile names like Sydney Sweeney joining the project. Still, hard details on exactly what Netflix's live-action adaptation of the legendary mech anime series will look like have been almost non-existent.

item.title: Tomb Raider's 2027's Return Looks Stunning in New Official Footage
item.description: The original Tomb Raider game celebrated its 30th anniversary this weekend, marking the 3D platforming adventure's release on Sega Saturn — yes, it came to Sega's doomed 3D console before its PlayStation and PC release a month later. To mark the occasion, developers Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog, and publisher Amazon Game Studios, revealed a new look at the game originally meant to celebrate that milestone: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis .

item.title: 15 Years Later, Batman: Arkham City Remains Batman's Last Gaming Masterpiece
item.description: Batman: Arkham Asylum was released in 2009 at a time when superhero video games were usually relegated to being uninspired movie tie-ins. Some of them were good, like X-Men Origins: Wolverine , but most of them were either forgettable or downright bad. Arkham Asylum was something different — a superhero game based on an original idea from a renowned Batman writer, Paul Dini ( Batman: The Animated Series ). It was great, and set the foundation for its even greater 2011 follow-up.

item.title: 6 Hilarious 'Calvin and Hobbes' Comics Where Calvin is a Weird Little Genius
item.description: Calvin and Hobbes came along at just the right time to influence a generation of creators, many of whom would go on to create comic strips of their own. Alongside a couple of other seminal '90s newspaper comics like Bloom County/Outland , C&H 's linework, flexibility, and imagination visibly inspired many of the artists who worked in the 2000s webcomics boom.

item.title: Clayface Gives Skydance Its Second Box Office Weekend Win In A Row
item.description: Initial estimates for Clayface's opening weekend box office are in, and the lower-budget horror film took the top spot with a $24.5 million gross. Its success means Skydance, the company created when Paramount and Warner Bros. merged, has topped the box office for two straight weeks.
